rules.correction: Queue workers from all Command Centers until saturation (target 28+ workers by 4:00, 32+ by 5:00). If production is below 2, add a Barracks or Factory (prerequisite: supply available). If bank exceeds 1500, add production structures (Barracks/Factory) or start an upgrade (e.g., +1 infantry weapons) if prerequisites are met. Keep army supply above 15 before considering an expansion.
rules.title: Maintain production tempo and worker saturation
rules.when: Time >= 240 and (workers < 28 or production < 2 or bank > 1500)

rules.correction: Add anti-air capability: produce Marines from Barracks, add a Missile Turret at each mineral line, or build a Cyclone from a Factory (prerequisite: Factory with tech lab). Maintain ground army production and continue economy/technology development.
rules.title: Adapt to enemy air composition
rules.when: Enemy Intelligence indicates air units (e.g., Oracles, Phoenixes, Void Rays) and your army lacks anti-air (e.g., no Marines, no Missile Turrets, no Cyclones)

rules.correction: Immediately convert bank into army: queue units from all production structures (Barracks, Factory, Starport) and add production if idle. Prioritize combat units over workers. Do not expand or start new upgrades until army supply is above 15 and bank is below 1000.
rules.title: Recover from low army and high bank
rules.when: Army supply < 15 and bank > 2000 and (predicted advantage is OverwhelmingDisadvantage or threat flags indicate imminent attack)
